module_summary: 8-bit ripple-carry adder built from eight chained full_adder instances, carry propagating through wire c to cout.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Operand A, bit-sliced into the eight full adders.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Operand B, bit-sliced into the eight full adders.

anchors.name: sum
anchors.why: 8-bit sum assembled from per-bit full adder outputs.

anchors.name: c
anchors.why: Ripple carry chain linking full adder i cout to adder i+1 cin.

anchors.name: cout
anchors.why: Final carry-out, copy of the last ripple carry c[7].

anchors.name: cin
anchors.why: Carry-in feeding the first full adder FA0.

groups.name: ripple_carry_chain
groups.description: Eight cascaded full adders producing sum bits and rippling carry to cout.
